findings.evidence: listQuestions() originally called assetOperations.getAssets(q.getAssetIds()) once per question inside the page .map(), producing 1+N queries per page.
findings.why_it_matters: Quadratic query cost on the list endpoint scales badly as question banks grow and the endpoint is called frequently during authoring.
findings.required_action: Batch-collect all asset IDs across the page, call assetOperations.getAssets() once, and map results back per-question via an in-memory Map keyed by AssetResponse.publicId.
